scientific_integrity: The proof enumerates all Demazure roots from the nested graph fan and derives the connected group from established complete-toric automorphism theory; calculations on 770 small connected labeled graphs are separate bounded regression tests. The star-graph additive-action specialization is existing literature, not a new claim.
scientific_limitations: Connected graphs on at least three vertices over the complex numbers; identity component only. The disconnected automorphism group, graph-order-two boundary and other base fields are not classified. Finite program tests do not certify the infinite theorem.
title: Leaf vertices determine connected automorphisms of graph-associahedral toric varieties
